promo.metaTitle: Sign in as an early user
promo.heading: The early-user offer applies to you
promo.body: Sign in or create an account, and the current journey stays free for you. The NIS 2 walkthrough costs {price} net a year. The account itself costs nothing.
promo.expiredBody: The early-user offer through this link was available until {date}. You can still sign in or create an account, on the terms that apply to your account.

auth.title: Start NIS2 compliance
auth.description: Create an account or sign in.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errorEmailNotVerified: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox for the code we sent.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.errorGooglePasswordAccount: This address has an account with a password. Please sign in with your password.
auth.errorGoogleAccountMismatch: This address is linked to a different Google account. Sign in with that account, or set a password with "Forgot password?".
auth.errorGoogleEmailChanged: The address of this Google account has changed. Please contact support at {email}.
auth.termsNotice: By continuing, you accept the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.verifyTitle: One last step: verify your email
auth.verifyDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. One-time check that you own this address. After this, you sign in with your password only. No more codes.
auth.verifyResent: New code sent. Check your inbox.
auth.verifyResendCooldown: Wait a few minutes before requesting another code.
auth.verifyErrorInvalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Try again or request a new one.
auth.verifyErrorSignInFailed: Email confirmed. Signing in did not work because a different password is stored for this address. Set a new one with "Forgot password".

twoFactor.codeDescription: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the six-digit code it shows for this account.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: One of the ten codes you saved when you set it up. Each works once.
twoFactor.useRecovery: Phone not at hand? Use a recovery code
twoFactor.useApp: Use the code from the app after all
twoFactor.noAccess: No phone and no codes left? Write to {email}. We check who you are and reset your second factor.
twoFactor.errorInvalid: That code does not match. Use the code the app shows now; each one works only once.
twoFactor.errorUnavailable: Signing in with a code is not available here right now. Please contact whoever runs this installation.
twoFactor.setupTitle: Set up sign-in with a code
twoFactor.setupDescription: Your account needs a code from an app on your phone as well as your password.
twoFactor.setupScan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, for example Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or your password manager.
twoFactor.setupQrAlt: QR code for setting up the app
twoFactor.setupManual: Can't scan? Enter the key by hand
twoFactor.setupSave: Save these ten recovery codes somewhere safe, such as your password manager. Each one gets you in once if your phone is missing. You only see them now.
twoFactor.setupConfirm: Enter the code the app shows now.
twoFactor.setupError: The setup could not start. Please sign in again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address. We will send you a 6-digit code you can use to set a new password.
forgotPassword.codeSentInfo: If an account with this address exists, a code is on its way. Enter the code and a new password below.
forgotPassword.resetDescription: Enter the code from the email sent to {email} and choose a new password.
forgotPassword.errorResetFailed: Invalid or expired code. Please request a new one.

setup.title: Set up your access
setup.description: Your account for the NIS 2 walkthrough is ready. Choose how you will sign in.
setup.invalidDescription: The link has expired or was already used. Sign in with Google, or set a password for this email address through "Forgot password".
